page.title: Fleet
page.purpose: Show an operator where the fleet's experience debt is worst and route them into the offending scenario in one glance.

priorities.statement: The worst-scoring scenarios are the first thing read.
Fleet-wide spec coverage and depth are summarizable at a glance.
Every row visibly leads somewhere — drilling in is the obvious next act.

states.description: Scenarios ranked worst-first by experience debt.
Sweep in progress; skeleton rows, no layout shift on arrival.
No scenario has an experience/ folder yet — the day-one state. Guidance, not blank space.
Sweep data older than its freshness budget; shown but visibly dated.
Sweep failed; what happened and the retry affordance.

regions.purpose: Render the fleet sweep's loading, ready, empty, stale, or failed result surface.

elements.name: Experience debt
elements.description: Scenarios ranked worst-first: coverage, depth distribution, debt score.

elements.name: Fleet depth
elements.description: Aggregate L0–L4 depth distribution across the fleet.

elements.name: Spec coverage
elements.description: Share of scenarios with any experience spec.
Per-row drill-in to the Scenario Explorer.

claims.statement: The experience-debt table is exposed as a real table with its accessible name, in every viewport.
The fleet summary (depth + coverage) precedes the debt table in reading order, so the aggregate lands before the detail.
Every scenario row's drill-in link is keyboard reachable.
The experience-debt table exposes search, sort, and status-filter controls so operators can find and triage scenarios.
The empty state renders dedicated guidance toward authoring a first spec — never blank space.
claims.rationale: v1 BAS reconciliation captures only the default state; this empty-state promise needs multi-state capture before it can be machine tier.

claims.statement: Stale sweep data is distinguishable from fresh data without reading timestamps closely.
claims.rationale: Requires a seeded stale sweep state; default live reconciliation cannot make stale data reachable yet.

claims.statement: Rows are ordered worst-first; the top row is always the scenario with the highest experience debt.
claims.rationale: Data-dependent ordering; machine-checkable only with seeded fixtures. Promotion candidate once the fleet sweep exposes a deterministic fixture mode.

claims.statement: No action competes with reading the table; the page is read-first and the only prominent affordances are drill-in and refresh.
claims.rationale: Becomes checkable via saliency importance ranking in the P2 perception tier.
